name: Docs and translation
description: Writing, translating and reviewing documentation. Use when the issue asks for a README change, a guide or a translation.
author: ContribMatch community

vocabulary.pull request: A change to words on a page, with the same shape as the original text.

documentation: Quote the sentence you would change and say what is wrong with it now.
Leave code blocks untouched unless the issue asks for them.
translation: Keep command names, file paths and code exactly as they are.
Say which file you would translate and which languages it would cover.
markdown: Name the heading or section you would add.
Match the heading level and the link style the file already uses.
